cards.text: Jesus has been up on a mountain with three of His disciples: Peter, John and James. The next day they come down, and a large crowd meets Him at the bottom. It's like coming back from one day off to 300 emails, except these emails have FEET.
Suddenly a man in the crowd cries out. He begs Jesus to look at his son, his only child.

cards.question: What's wrong with the man's only son?

answers.text: A fever will not leave him
He has been blind from birth

cards.text: The father lays it all out. The spirit makes the boy scream, throws him into convulsions until he foams at the mouth, keeps mauling him, and rarely leaves him.

cards.question: Before Jesus came down the mountain, the father begged Jesus' ___ to drive the spirit out.

cards.text: And they were unable. Jesus replies, “O unbelieving and perverse generation!”

cards.question: Jesus asks, “How long must I remain with you and put up with you?” Then what does He tell the father?

answers.text: Go home and he will be well
Wait for Me in the town

cards.text: Even while the boy is on his way over, the demon slams him to the ground in a convulsion. Friend, that spirit is NOT going quietly.

cards.question: The demon has the boy on the ground right in front of Jesus. What does Jesus do?

answers.text: Rebukes the spirit and heals the boy
Tells His disciples to try again
Sends the boy to see the priest

cards.question: Once the boy is healed, Jesus gives him back to his father.

cards.text: Everyone is astonished at the greatness of God. And while they're all marveling, Jesus tells His disciples, “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”

cards.question: The disciples understand right away what Jesus means about the Son of Man being delivered into the hands of men.

cards.text: It's veiled from them so they can't comprehend it, and they're afraid to ask Him about it. You know that meeting where the boss says something heavy, everybody nods real slow, and NOBODY raises a hand?

cards.question: Then an argument starts among the disciples. What's it about?

answers.text: Which of them would be the greatest
Which of them should carry the money
Which town they should go to next

cards.text: They're arguing about which of them would be the greatest. I've refereed that argument before, between the dead batteries in my old junk drawer, and friend, NOT ONE of them had any charge left.
But Jesus knows the thoughts of their hearts. He doesn't say a word yet. He just has someone come stand beside Him.

cards.question: While the disciples argue about who's the greatest, who does Jesus have stand beside Him?
Jesus says whoever welcomes this little child in His name is welcoming ___.

cards.text: And Jesus keeps going: whoever welcomes Him welcomes the One who sent Him. Then He speaks right to that argument.

cards.question: Jesus tells the arguing disciples that whoever is the least among them is the greatest.

cards.text: Then John speaks up. “Master,” he says, and he tells Jesus about a man they saw doing something in His name.

cards.question: John tells Jesus they saw a man doing something in Jesus' name. What was the man doing?
The disciples tried to stop the man driving out demons in Jesus' name. Why, according to John?

answers.text: He was not traveling with them
He was one of the Pharisees

cards.text: Picture it. A man is out there driving out demons in Jesus' name, and the disciples walk up like, “Excuse me, sir… are you with the group?”

cards.question: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replies. His reason: whoever is not ___ you is for you.
